thread:
support_jake: 02:16 UTC - getting multiple customer tickets: API calls suddenly returning 401/403 and some 503s after last night's rotation. Customers TKT-4337 and TKT-4339. Escalating to infra oncall.

ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: auth-service error_rate spike detected (x12). affected endpoints: /v1/token, /v1/validate. Pager duty trigger at 02:17 UTC.

ajay_oncall: I'm on it. can someone confirm whether credential rotation ran at ~02:13? @maria_prod?

maria_prod: yes, rotation job kicked 2026-03-14T02:13:42Z. rollout flag rotation-v2 enabled in prod. no rollback at that time.

ajay_oncall: I'm seeing jwt verification failures in auth-verify logs: "kid not found" repeated. snippet:
```
ERROR auth-verify: jwt: invalid signature, kid not found, kid=\"k-2026-03-14-02\"
```

sylvie_sec: that sounds like a JWK mismatch between signer and verifier. oauth-proxy/jwks cache might still have old keys. can someone curl the jwks endpoint?

ben_platform: ran a quick check: https://auth.internal/.well-known/jwks.json returned only pre-rotation keys until service restart. fetcher telemetry shows last successful fetch 02:10 and then rotation at 02:13. logs:
```
warn jwks-fetcher: cache ttl=300s, last_refresh=02:10:12, rotation_detected=true, skipping-refresh=true
```

ajay_oncall: repro steps for eng to reproduce locally:
1) export TOKEN from before rotation (old signed JWT)
2) curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
-> Response: HTTP/1.1 401 
{"error":"invalid_token","reason":"kid not found"}

3) restart auth-service and oauth-proxy (to refresh jwks)
4) repeat curl -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK

support_jake: we have customers reporting degraded UX (UI can't list models too). I've informed support triage.

ajay_oncall: immediate mitigation applied: forced JWKS refresh + rolling restart of oauth-proxy instances in prod region. also temporarily dropped cache TTL and disabled the skip-refresh-on-rotation logic. verified with multi-region curl checks.

maria_prod: confirmed downstream services started accepting tokens after restart. monitoring shows auth error rate back to baseline after 02:30.

sylvie_sec: root cause hypothesis: rotation orchestration created a new signing key in KMS and updated the signer, but the verification side relied on a stale cache + a guard that avoided refresh during perceived churn. that guard prevented an immediate fetch of the new JWKs.

ben_platform: follow-ups: (1) remove skip-refresh logic, (2) trigger an immediate JWK fetch on any rotation event, (3) add alert on repeated "kid not found" spikes (>5/min), (4) add end-to-end rotation test in canary where signer and verifier both get new key and verify traffic. I've created a ticket: PLAT-5721.

maria_prod: opening RFC for rotation orchestration improvements and KMS lifecycle docs, assigning to ben_platform.

sylvie_sec: linking runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-rotation> and will draft sec postmortem items. marking incident P1 -> postmortem.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: auth-service error_rate back to baseline; automatic alert cleared at 02:34 UTC.

support_jake: notifying affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem. closing support tickets pending postmortem. :white_check_mark: 

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed by ajay_oncall. Duration ~18m.

-- end of thread --
